messages:
Maria: Morning team — quick celebratory blurt: GA rollout finished and we just crossed $85M ARR this quarter :tada: :confetti_ball:
Theo: WHAT. :scream: That is massive, congrats everyone!!
Priya: Huge!! Also flagged: first EU Dedicated customer went live at 03:14 UTC last night. Smooth as butter 🎉
Jo: Cake or croissants? We need a plan for sugar logistics. :cake: :croissant:
Theo: I’ll bring croissants at 09:30 — consider it my contribution to the economy of carbs
Maria: Shoutout to eng-runtime and eng-sre — midnight failover was handled cleanly. Seriously impressive. @eng-sre you heroes :heart:
engbot: Deploy 2026.03.22-14:01 succeeded on all regions (10 nodes). :white_check_mark:
Priya: Dashboard team — the GA metrics panel looked sooo pretty on stage. You made graphs sexy again :raised_hands:
Ally: I have a bafflingly large gif library. Approving deployment of celebratory GIFs to this thread. Will post one shortly.
Theo: Post the gif!! :tada:
Jo: Quick poll — kitchen toast at 10 or virtual champagne at 11? React with :kitchen: for in-person or :champagne: for remote.
Priya: :champagne:
Maria: :champagne: — remote works for me, coffee + bubbly at my desk
Theo: :kitchen: (I’ll still bring croissants for whoever’s in the office)
Sara: Huge props to Ops — midnight pager on DB failover and they owned it. Can we give a kudos thread?
Maria: Yes, Ops kudos incoming. I’ll pin a thread in #eng-sre for shoutouts.
Priya: Fun metric: cost-per-token dropped ~12% after the new kernel changes. Small wins piling up.
Ally: If nobody posts a cake picture I will Photoshop a cupcake on the console screenshot. Odds are good. 🧁
engbot: Reminder: All-hands Friday 9:00am — celebration segment added. Please RSVP in #all-hands.
Maria: Thanks all. Still a little stunned — this team is ridiculous in the best way. :sparkles:
